name: duel_caretaker_has_its_window_before_a_ready_horn
description: A player who presses Ready at once does not take the caretaker's window from it (Duel the caretaker, contract-m7 §2): the horn waits until the caretaken seat has said Ready, which the caretaker does on the first tick of the window both hollows share, after its corks and builds. Seat 1 plays its plan by command every 3 ticks and presses Ready as soon as each window opens; seat 2, the caretaker from tick 0, still says Ready before every horn, corks in at least as many windows as when seat 1 waits out every window (8 against 5 since its plan waits while its window does, so it corks first on the shared window's first tick: duel_caretaker_corks_before_its_plan_spends), and uncorks every bottle. Before the fix the horn sounded on the tick after the Drift, before the caretaker's think: 2 corks against 5.

steps.msg: the duel ran to its decision with the player Ready in every window
the caretaker said Ready before every horn

steps.assert: scene.duel_count(2, 'cork') >= waiting_corks and waiting_corks >= 4 and scene.duel_count(2, 'uncork') == scene.duel_count(2, 'cork')
steps.msg: and corked at least as often as against a player who waits out every window, uncorking each bottle
